conflict_resolutions.FULL_AND_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT: Resolved: EO 8512 sec. 9 expressly revokes EO 5614 by number in full; the partial reading comes only from the additional generic 'all other orders or parts thereof inconsistent' clause in the same sentence, which does not limit the named whole revocation.

research_rationale:
Original: EO 5614 of May 1, 1931 (Reporting of Expenditures for Use in the Budget), read in full in the official OFR 1974 Hoover PEO vol. II, printed p. 838 (PDF p. 67): enacting sentence under the Budget and Accounting Act, three numbered paragraphs, signature and number; the held OCR is complete. Ending: EO 8512 of August 13, 1940 (5 FR 2849, held govinfo FR PDF text), Section 9: 'Executive Orders No. 5614 of May 1, 1931, No. 6226 of July 27, 1933, No. 6869 ... and all other orders or parts thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this order are hereby revoked.' EO 8512 states no other effective date, so the revocation took effect on signing, August 13, 1940 (filed August 14, 1940). All three paragraphs end together on that date.
Member checks: {"earlier_end_check":"No earlier end found. The only related prior order held, EO 6226 of July 27, 1933 (encumbrance/apportionment reports; held APP text), governs a different subject (obligations and apportionments) and does not amend or revoke EO 5614; EO 8512 revoking both in the same list confirms EO 5614 was still extant in 1940. The 1933 consolidation of disbursing in Treasury changed which officers disburse but not the duty to report expenditures. The order has no own-term limit. Pre-1937 events are outside the OFR catalog search; this gap is covered by reading the revoking and related orders, not by the catalog alone.","independent_command_check":"Paragraph 3 (Treasury forms) is a dependent implementing authority that falls with the order; no paragraph is an independent command surviving the revocation. EO 8512 replaces the subject with its own regulations, which are EO 8512's commands, not continuations of EO 5614.","savings_check":"EO 8512 contains no savings clause for actions under EO 5614; reports already furnished were completed acts with no continuing EO-traceable condition.","scope_check":"The revocation names EO 5614 by number and date and revokes it entirely; the general 'parts thereof inconsistent' wording is additional and does not narrow the express whole revocation. Each of paragraphs 1-3 ends on 1940-08-13."}
